hero.highlight: Prepare in as little as 6 months
hero.title: Medical Office Assistant
hero.description: Learn front office and administrative skills to support healthcare teams. Combine classroom instruction with a supervised externship to gain real-world experience.

whyStudy.title: Why Study Medical Office Assistant at PCI Health
whyStudy.description: PCI Health prepares students from diverse backgrounds for front-office healthcare careers through practical training, supportive services, and industry-relevant curriculum.

items.title: Career Opportunities
items.description: Prepare for roles such as Medical Front Office Assistant, Medical Office Manager, Insurance Processor, Billing and Collections Specialist, and Patient Care Coordinator.

items.title: Fast, Focused Program
items.description: Complete training in as little as 6 months with a combined 400 hours of classroom instruction and a 200-hour externship.

items.title: Hands-on Practical Training
items.description: Train in a simulated medical office, learn EHR procedures, medical records management, procedural coding for billing, basic medical terminology, first aid, and CPR.

items.title: Supportive Student Services
items.description: Ongoing support from enrollment through career placement, including job search strategies, resume writing, and interview practice.

items.title: Positive Job Outlook
items.description: Employment of Medical Office Assistants is projected to grow 4% from 2024 to 2034 (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics).

items.title: Admissions Assistance
items.description: Guidance through enrollment and program selection to help you start your training.

items.title: Financial Aid & Resources
items.description: Information about financial aid options and consumer information to help make training accessible.

items.title: Career Services
items.description: Job search support, resume development, and interview preparation to aid in post-graduation employment.

items.title: Real-world Experience
items.description: A 200-hour externship provides supervised, hands-on administrative experience in healthcare settings.

items.title: Accredited Training
items.description: Training from an ACCSC-accredited institution with state approval from the Texas Workforce Commission.

items.title: Multiple Campuses
items.description: Program available at Dallas (Southwest Dallas) and Richardson (Northeast Dallas) campuses.
